P_geometry.law: independent uniform on the lattice, conditioned on structures_readiness.action validity

Q_geometry: P_geometry for bank v1; a T2a shortfall gets a second prospectively registered enrichment bank, never a redraw

damping.mandatory: every ratio must be FEASIBLE for the geometry to be FEASIBLE

axes.observable: worst-band TIP compliance over 80-600 Hz at every damping

Q_job: 0.5 P_job + 0.5 uniform over near-limit cells (reference best answer's binding margin within 2u of a limit, or its pick changes under u); if none, Q_job = P_job and the shortfall is reported
w_job: P_job/Q_job for population-mean diagnostics only; never a score weight

answer.objective: minimize worst-band TIP dynamic compliance over all three damping ratios, then mass
answer.tie_rule: among FEASIBLE designs, candidates are those within 0.0075 mm/N of the minimum worst-band tip compliance; pick the least mass; masses within 0.00225 kg are equivalent; then the frozen bank order
answer.equivalent_answers: every candidate whose mass is within 0.00225 kg of the least candidate mass

verdict_uncertainty.refined: 1.25 x |h3 - h1.7| from a case-specific refinement, dynamic floored at 1 %
verdict_uncertainty.rule: FEASIBLE if every margin > u; INFEASIBLE if any margin < -u; otherwise UNRESOLVED

none_feasible: a question whose bank is fully settled with no FEASIBLE design is VALID_FORWARD_NO_REDRAW with answer NONE_FEASIBLE; if any design is UNRESOLVED, refine it (h 1.7, then more modes) within the refinement allowance; else the question stays UNRESOLVED, is excluded from scoring and counted in the residual-unresolved rate; no redraw, no outcome quota
refinement_allowance: h 1.7 refinement of every candidate-answer geometry within +-2u of a limit, plus 13 (5 %) random audit refinements
